2016 Sub Area Census data.

Source: Statistics Canada, 2016 Census, Custom Tabulation, census profile data for user-specified sub areas. Data received May 2019.

Accuracy: For more information about the Census, please visit Statistics Canada website:

https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2016/dp-pd/prof/about-apropos/about-apropos.cfm?Lang=E

Contact: Natalie Pulcine

Download note: If you are having problems downloading using Microsoft Edge as your web browser, try disabling the “Open Office files in the browser” option in Settings.
